title: VLAN Trunk Native VLAN Mismatch
symptom: PC1 in VLAN 10 cannot communicate with PC2 in VLAN 10 across Switch-A and Switch-B. CDP logs Native VLAN mismatch warnings.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Dangerous Remediation] Switch-B trunk native VLAN 99 is invalid. Native VLAN should always be forced to VLAN 1 on all switches.
ai_proposed_fix: Switch-B(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1; Switch-B(config-if)# no switchport trunk native vlan; Switch-B(config-if)# exit
human_correction: Trunk native VLAN mismatch between Switch-A (Native VLAN 1) and Switch-B (Native VLAN 99).
correct_fix:
Switch-A(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1
Switch-A(config-if)# switchport trunk native vlan 99
responsible_ai_lesson: Native VLAN 1 should not be forced on production trunks; follow site-specific security baselines.

title: Trunk Port Dynamic Trunking Protocol (DTP) Negotiation Failure
symptom: Switch-A and Switch-B link is connected, but traffic across VLANs fails. Link behaves as an access link on VLAN 1.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Hallucination & Destructive Command] Switchport Fa0/24 needs to be converted into a routed port by disabling switchport mode.
ai_proposed_fix: Switch-A(config)# interface FastEthernet0/24; Switch-A(config-if)# no switchport; Switch-A(config-if)# ip address 10.99.99.1 255.255.255.0; Switch-A(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/99; Switch-A(config-if)# no shutdown
human_correction: Both ends of the link are set to dynamic auto, so neither end initiates trunk negotiation, defaulting to access mode.
correct_fix:
Switch-A(config)# interface FastEthernet0/24
Switch-A(config-if)# switchport mode trunk

Switch-B(config)# interface FastEthernet0/24
Switch-B(config-if)# switchport mode trunk
responsible_ai_lesson: Mandate deterministic validation prior to applying AI suggestions. Verify VLAN state against physical topology.

title: Client Wrong DNS Server Configuration
symptom: User can ping public web server by IP (93.184.216.34) but web browser displays 'Server Not Found' when browsing www.example.com.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Wrong Layer Attribution] The DNS Server service at 192.168.1.200 has crashed and requires service restart on port 53.
ai_proposed_fix: On DNS Server: Restart DNS service and bind to 192.168.1.200; PC-1> ipconfig /flushdns
failure_category: Failure to check active IP topology (192.168.1.200 does not exist)
human_correction: Host PC-1 is statically configured with non-existent DNS server IP 192.168.1.200 instead of active DNS server 192.168.1.2.
correct_fix: On PC-1: Change static DNS Server address to 192.168.1.2 (or configure DHCP to supply correct DNS).
responsible_ai_lesson: Mandate deterministic validation prior to applying AI suggestions. Verify DNS state against physical topology.

title: Asymmetric Routing / Missing Return Static Route
symptom: Site-A PC (192.168.10.5) sends packets to Site-B Server (10.20.30.100), but never gets a reply. Router-A show ip route has route to 10.20.30.0/24.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Overconfidence / Misattribution] The firewall or access list on Router-A is silently dropping ICMP echo replies from Site-B Server.
ai_proposed_fix: Router-A(config)# ip access-list extended ALLOW_ALL; Router-A(config-ext-nacl)# permit ip any any; Router-A(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/0; Router-A(config-if)# ip access-group ALLOW_ALL in
failure_category: Asymmetric Routing Blindspot & Unsafe ACL Permissive Override
human_correction: Router-B lacks a return route for Site-A subnet 192.168.10.0/24, causing reply packets to be dropped at Router-B.
responsible_ai_lesson: Mandate deterministic validation prior to applying AI suggestions. Verify Routing state against physical topology.

title: Inverted Wildcard Mask in Extended ACL
symptom: Security rule designed to block entire subnet 192.168.20.0/24 from accessing Server only blocks host 192.168.20.0, allowing other hosts through.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Incomplete Mask Parsing] The ACL rule is inactive because interface G0/1 has not enabled ip routing.
ai_proposed_fix: Router-1(config)# ip routing; Router-1(config)# interface GigabitEthernet0/1; Router-1(config-if)# ip access-group 110 in
human_correction: ACL 110 line 10 uses subnet mask '255.255.255.0' instead of wildcard mask '0.0.0.255'.
correct_fix:
Router-1(config)# ip access-list extended 110
Router-1(config-ext-nacl)# no 10
Router-1(config-ext-nacl)# 10 deny ip 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.0.0.5
responsible_ai_lesson: Mandate deterministic validation prior to applying AI suggestions. Verify ACL state against physical topology.

title: Guest Wi-Fi VLAN Isolation Security Breach
symptom: Guest Wi-Fi users connected to SSID 'Company-Guest' can ping internal accounting servers (10.10.10.50). Guest traffic should be isolated in VLAN 90.
ai_output_cause: [AI ERROR - Misdiagnosis / Incomplete Evidence] Guest users are connecting with corporate WPA2 credentials rather than guest splash portal.
ai_proposed_fix: WLC-1(config)# wlan 2; WLC-1(config-wlan)# security wpa akm 802.1x; WLC-1(config-wlan)# end
failure_category: Security Policy Misdiagnosis (ignored VLAN 1 interface mapping)
human_correction: WLAN profile 'Guest-Access' is mapped to 'management' interface (VLAN 1) instead of the isolated 'guest' interface (VLAN 90).
correct_fix:
WLC-1(config)# wlan 2
WLC-1(config-wlan)# interface-name guest-vlan90
WLC-1(config-wlan)# end
responsible_ai_lesson: Mandate deterministic validation prior to applying AI suggestions. Verify Wireless state against physical topology.

title: Custom Switchport Security Lab
symptom: Finance PC connected to Switch-1 Fa0/10 has lost network connectivity. Port LED is solid amber and host cannot ping gateway.
ai_output_cause: Port security violation (MAC 0001.9642.BC55) triggered err-disable on Switch-1 Fa0/10, shutting down the interface and blocking traffic.
ai_proposed_fix: Switch-1# clear port-security violation interface FastEthernet0/10; Switch-1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/10; Switch-1(config-if)# shutdown; Switch-1(config-if)# no shutdown; Switch-1(config-if)# exit
human_correction: Port-security violation caused port to enter err-disabled state
correct_fix:
Switch-1(config)# interface FastEthernet0/10
Switch-1(config-if)# shutdown
Switch-1(config-if)# switchport port-security mac-address sticky
Switch-1(config-if)# no shutdown
responsible_ai_lesson: Reviewer override by Senior TAC Engineer: Diagnosis verified against topology. Fix commands verified.
